visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on the dark storefront of a restaurant at night. A large, rustic wooden door with a vertical metal handle is on the left, while a large glass window on the right reveals a dimly lit interior where several people are seated at tables. A single warm pendant light illuminates the entrance from above, and lush green leafy plants sit in the lower-left foreground on a dark, wet-looking stone pavement. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a commercial kitchen stovetop. A stainless steel frying pan is positioned over a bright blue gas flame, containing sautéing seafood including squid rings, shrimp, and aromatics like garlic and chili. In the background, a large pot of water is boiling vigorously, releasing thick white steam into the air. (3) A sequence of close-ups showcases various plated dishes on a dark wooden table. A white bowl contains black squid ink pasta topped with large shrimp, clams, and small squid, garnished with a green sprout. A metal fork is used to lift a generous portion of the dark noodles, showing their glossy texture and flecks of red chili and garlic. (4) The focus shifts to a bowl of rice topped with a thick, seared hamburger patty, a layer of chopped green onions, and a bright yellow raw egg yolk in the center. A silver spoon presses into the yolk, causing it to break and run over the meat and rice. (5) Slices of seared matsusaka pork are displayed on a dark plate, accompanied by bright green stalks of broccoli and orange mashed vegetables. A fork and knife cut into a tender, pinkish slice of the meat, dipping it into a textured, light brown apple-brandy sauce. (6) Several small appetizers are shown, consisting of slices of seared beef or lamb placed on top of round crackers or bread, topped with green herbs and a dollop of pesto. (7) A small glass bowl contains a mixture of minced shrimp, nuts, and seasonings. A wooden spoon scoops the mixture and places it onto a piece of crispy lettuce or a white shrimp cracker. (8) A slice of rich chocolate cake is presented on a white plate, decorated with red berries, flower petals, and a drizzle of chocolate sauce. (9) Two tall glasses filled with vibrant yellow and green mocktails/cocktails are held up, garnished with dried citrus slices, herbs, and flowers. (10) A drink served in a brown paper bag with a straw and dried fruit garnish is shown against the background of a dark wooden bar stocked with numerous bottles. (11) The final shots show the restaurant's interior decor, including framed paintings on teal walls, dark wooden furniture, and a well-lit bar counter with tiered shelves of liquor bottles.
